findings.where: rotated y-axis title 'CLOUD SPEND · $K / MO' and axis ticks
findings.evidence: Sampled pixels: axis title ink ~#a6adb8 on #f5f5f5 page, about 2.1:1, at roughly 8px cap height and rotated 90 degrees; the units of the whole chart live only in this label.
findings.after: Darken to >= #5a6170 (>= 4.5:1), set >= 12px, and repeat the unit in the title or first tick ('$k/mo')
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum); the unit is essential information.

findings.evidence: Value labels render at about 9-10px in a light mono on a 1200px-wide image; at typical embed widths (600-800px) they fall to ~6px.
findings.after: >= 12px at the delivered width; bold the signed values
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.4 Resize Text: text in an image cannot be enlarged without loss; keep it above floor at its delivered size.

strengths: Cost added vs removed is encoded by fill vs outline, and the highlight by a bordered tint, so meaning survives in grayscale (T-GRAYSCALE passes).
not_investigated: Image-only item: alt text, reading order, keyboard and focus checks not possible; the delivered alt text is unknown and must state the bridge values and total.
Exact contrast of value labels on bar fills was not sampled.
